build_mae_model: build a MAE vision transformer model using MaeModel.build_model with a MaeConfig
create_mae_config: create a MaeConfig dataclass to configure input size, patch size, embed dim, and mask ratio
run_mae_forward: run the MaeModel forward pass on image tensors to compute masked autoencoding loss
test_random_masking: test the MaeModel random_masking method to verify per-sample patch masking and restoration
review_altblock: review the AltBlock class and its forward method for alternative transformer block behavior
